# BigQuery observations for geography_line_interpolation

SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0, 10 20)'), 0.5)
=> "POINT(10 5)"

SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(170 10, -170 10)'), 0.5)
=> "POINT(-180 10.1510817110481)"

SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), 0.5)
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), -1)
=> error: ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT: ST_LineInterpolatePoint: fraction should be between 0 and 1. Actual value was -1.000000; error in ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT expression

SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(0 0)'), 0.5)
=> error: ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT: Argument to ST_LineInterpolatePoint must be a single line geography; an argument contained a point. Error in ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT expression

SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTILINESTRING((0 0, 1 0), (2 0, 3 0))'), 0.5)
=> error: ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT: Argument to ST_LineInterpolatePoint must be a single line geography; an argument had 2 lines. Error in ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT expression

SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0)'), -0.1)
=> error: ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT: ST_LineInterpolatePoint: fraction should be between 0 and 1. Actual value was -0.100000; error in ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT expression

SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0)'), CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64))
=> error: ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT: ST_LineInterpolatePoint: fraction should be between 0 and 1. Actual value was nan; error in ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT expression

SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0)'), CAST('+inf' AS FLOAT64))
=> error: ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT: ST_LineInterpolatePoint: fraction should be between 0 and 1. Actual value was inf; error in ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT expression

# BigQuery geography function documentation.

SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 5 5)'), 0)
=> "POINT(1 1)"

SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 5 5)'), 0.5)
=> "POINT(2.99633827268976 3.00182528336078)"

SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 5 5)'), 1)
=> "POINT(5 5)"

SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 5 5)'), NULL)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)'), -1)
=> null

SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY), 0.5)
=> null
